You deserve to feel better. At Neuro Wellness Spa, our expertly trained psychiatrists and thoughtfully designed centers provide compassionate, personalized treatment for a wide range of mental health conditions, helping you achieve meaningful, lasting change.
Often just thought of as profound sadness, depression can also look like a lack of interest in people or activities.
While everyone worries, those with anxiety find that their fears interfere with their daily activities.
Uncontrollable or recurring thoughts (obsessions) or repetitive and excessive behaviors (compulsions) interfere with daily life for those with OCD.
A pattern of using substances like drugs or alcohol often leads to harmful consequences to physical and mental health, work, or relationships.
ADHD is characterized by difficulty focusing, hyperactivity, and impulsivity that interferes with daily life.
Witnessing a traumatic event can have a major impact on wellbeing and health for many years to come.
Between hormonal changes, the psychological adjustment to motherhood, and exhaustion, depression affects approximately 1 in 8 new mothers.
When stress piles up or doesn’t let up, it can get harder to cope, leading to persistent, unrelenting tension.
Sometimes stress can come on quickly and feel paralyzing. Panic attacks are sudden, intense, can happen unexpectedly, and affect daily functioning.
Extreme shifts in mood, energy, activity levels, and concentration can make it impossible for those with bipolar disorder to carry out day-to-day activities.
Difficulty falling or staying asleep leads not only to fatigue throughout the day, but often irritability and trouble focusing.
There are many causes for trouble with memory, thinking, or decision-making. For those with impairment, it interferes with everyday life or work.
For some, cognitive impairment is a progressive decline over time, and can affect independence and quality of life.
A condition marked by unstable moods, relationships, and self-image, often with intense emotional reactions.
A neurodevelopmental condition that affects communication, social interaction, and behavior patterns in varying degrees.
When pain lasts for months or longer, it takes a toll on a whole person, affecting not just physical functioning but mood as well.
Widespread pain, fatigue, and sleep issues aren’t always easy to explain. Those with fibromyalgia may also be unusually sensitive to touch and stress.
Everyone has bouts of exhaustion, but when it is not easily explained, doesn’t improve with rest, and limits your activities or mental clarity, it is considered chronic fatigue.
Although many people are concerned about health, weight, or appearance, those with eating disorders become fixated on weight loss, body shape, and controlling their food intake.

The compassionate team at Neuro Wellness Spa works with you to determine the right mental health treatment for your challenges and goals, making sure you feel seen, supported, empowered, and connected throughout your wellness journey.
Our psychiatrists in Long Beach offer personalized mental health evaluations and treatment plans for anxiety, depression, and more. Our services are available both in person and via telehealth.

Our team supports families with teens facing emotional, behavioral, or academic challenges. Adolescent and teen psychiatric services are designed to help young people build coping skills, manage symptoms, address underlying issues, and achieve lasting well-being through personalized treatment.

Therapy sessions are available for clients seeking support with anxiety, mood disorders, or stress. Our licensed clinicians offer a range of evidence-based treatments in a calming setting, such as cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and mindfulness.

TMS is an FDA-cleared, non-invasive treatment for depression, OCD, and other mental health conditions. Our Long Beach location offers TMS therapy, which is ideal for those who haven’t found relief through traditional treatments such as psychiatric medications or talk therapy.
Neuro Wellness Spa has supported the wellbeing of patients throughout Southern California for over a decade.

mainEntity.name: Does Neuro Wellness Spa offer both in-person and virtual psychiatric appointments in Long Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Long Beach clinic provides both in-person and virtual (online) psychiatry services — including child/adolescent and adult care — along with medication management and TMS therapy.

mainEntity.name: Can I receive care for both medication support and therapy at Neuro Wellness Spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. At our Long Beach clinic, patients can access comprehensive care, including medication management, psychotherapy (e.g., talk therapy, CBT, DBT), and neuromodulation treatments like TMS and MeRT — all in one integrated setting.

mainEntity.name: Is TMS therapy available at the Neuro Wellness Spa Long Beach clinic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. We offer FDA-cleared transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) therapy at our Long Beach location, alongside psychiatry and therapy services.

mainEntity.name: How soon can I schedule a psychiatric appointment at Neuro Wellness Spa Long Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appointments are typically available in just days, not weeks, whether you choose an in-office or virtual visit.

mainEntity.name: Is psychiatric care at your Long Beach location available for teens or adults?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer adolescent psychiatry as well as adult services, available both in-person and virtually.

mainEntity.name: Where is Neuro Wellness Spa’s Long Beach psychiatry office located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Long Beach clinic is located at:5838 East Naples Plaza, Long Beach, CA 90803.

mainEntity.name: What should I expect during my first psychiatry visit at Neuro Wellness Spa, Long Beach?

acceptedAnswer.text: During your initial visit, you’ll undergo a comprehensive evaluation that may include discussing your medical and mental health history, current symptoms, lifestyle factors, and family history. From there, your provider will craft a personalized treatment plan, potentially incorporating medication, therapy, lifestyle guidance, TMS, or other appropriate services.
